[Package]
Name="frc_team_#3937_lib_memory_library"
Version="1.0.1.2"
Release=""
ID=4179a56847815684cf418d01ca22581d
File Format="vip"
Format Version="2017"
Display Name="Memory Library"


[Description]
Description="Below is an inclusive list of the vi's included in the library and their function. All vi's are configured so each instance has its own memory (if used multiple times, each time is completely independent of the others). \0A\0AEdge Detector:\0AThis vi can be used to detect the first time a signal becomes true, or false, or both. It is similar to the One-Shot Button (rising edge), but implements detecting when a signal becomes false (falling edge) or any edge as well. Its primary use is in conjunction with a joystick button and can be used to trigger an event on when the button is first pressed or similar using another mode.\0A\0ASR Flip FLop:\0AThis vi implements a software version of the hardware JK Latch with an enable bit. \0A\0AWhen Enable = False, no change\0AIf Set = True, output = true\0AIf Reset = True, output = false\0AIf Set and Reset both = True, output = toggle mode"
Summary="The memory library is a VI package of low level Boolean memory vi's that are built to allow for better code re-usability."
